# Scan fixtures

Byte copies of real FreeCAD exports, used by `shelving_core/tests/test_scan.py`
to prove the scanner against geometry no synthetic test would think to
construct. Do not hand-edit any file here: regenerate from the source FreeCAD
document via `spikes/plain_planks/export_boxes.py` (or `inspect_object.py`,
for the notched-panel record) and copy the result in.

- `real_stair_step.boxes.json`: a stepped unit from a real project, three
  columns of different heights sharing one floor.
- `real_two_units.boxes.json`: two abutting units exported from a loose
  selection rather than a tidy container, which still carries the pre-fix
  duplicate-name entries a selection reachable by two paths produces.
- `real_magicstart_f1.boxes.json`: a cabinet generated by Woodworking's
  `magicStart` variant F1.
- `real_notched_panel.inspect.json`: the inspection record (from
  `inspect_object.py`, not `export_boxes.py`) of a notched panel from a
  superseded revision, kept as a real example of a solid the scanner cannot
  read as a board.
